subject: english
title: Verb Engine App — Actions, BE, Time and Helpers
subtitle: Leo works the 8 stations on his own across 13 modules: the engine idea, engine hunt, the three word teams, BE verbs, the -s rule, two clocks, -ing, the past, the rebels, word order, helpers, and the closing quiz.

content: Find the verb in any sentence without prompting, including quiet verbs like know and have and the BE verb hiding in 'Leo is a fast runner'.
Separate nouns, verbs, and describing words using the three test frames, including word families such as win / winner / windy.
Choose between the two time clocks — a habit every day versus something happening right now — and rewind a sentence into the past.
language: Use am, is, are, was, and were correctly, and never omit the BE verb.
Add the third-person -s with the right spelling machine (+s, +es, consonant + y → -ies), avoid over-applying it to plural subjects, and produce have → has.

Build -ing and -ed forms with the correct spelling machine, produce ten irregular past rebels, keep the verb in the middle of the sentence, and choose Do / Does / Did for questions and negatives with only one ending in the sentence.
